note: Evil Mode slice 9, a region (design Part 2 sections 2, 4, 5 and 6; Part 3 sections 8 and 9; Part 26a sections 1 and 2; Part 29 section 3.2; Part 30 section 9). Kanto played whole: the Arrival, six districts, a soft Reckoning; the Road between districts and an Officer left behind; drift; the tally; the region's rule on one hook; the Look, Patron and first-region pages; the ways forward. Numbers are starting values; none are playtested. Text is data; the save keeps ids.

regions.name: Kanto
ticket: The neighbour: Rocket (Giovanni).
Everything's owned: Pay +10%; taking from a deeded holding, Heat +1 more.
Your Doctrine: at home in {homes} of six.
He'll send a fruit basket. Read the card.

rule.name: Everything's owned
rule.text: Half the holdings have deeds. Pay +10%; a Take from a deeded holding, Heat +1 more.

mods.label: Kanto: a deed has a lawyer

doors.why: Nobody Leans in a town they got off the boat in this morning.
Nobody Takes in a town they got off the boat in this morning.
Nobody here knows you well enough to believe you yet.

arrival.squadsWhy: One squad in the Arrival. The team's new here.
arrival.home: The Hero's at home on {street}. They'll leave town tomorrow.
arrival.leaves: The Hero's left home with their bag and their starter. Their mother's watching from the step.
arrival.badge: The Hero beat Brock. First Badge. They'll be quicker now.
arrival.end: The Arrival's over. Whatever you hold here pays all region.

patron: The Board. The Hero's marker. "That's them. Don't stare."
Dispatch and the Honest Card. "Read it to the end. I'll know if you didn't."
The Evening and the Ledger. "Every coin's got a name. Learn them."
The Hero. "There. First Badge. They'll be quicker now."
nobody: A note on the door, in your own hand: the Board first. The kid with the bag is the Hero. Don't stare.
A note on the door: read every Card to the end before you send anyone.
A note on the door: every coin in the Ledger has a name. Learn them.
A note on the door: they'll have a Badge by tonight. They'll be quicker after.

day: The eighth Badge. The Hero fights at Viridian without you: this Gym's always theirs. Everything of yours on their way is a fight or a wave.
The approach. The Hero sits outside. You have one last day.
The walk. The Hero comes up the road to the door.
reckoning.badge: The Hero beat Giovanni. Eight Badges. Tomorrow they sit outside.
reckoning.outside: The Hero's sitting on the wall across the road. They've been there since breakfast.
reckoning.end: The Hero came to the door, and Kanto's over. The last room is built in a later slice; the run goes on.
reckoning.over: Kanto's over. The Crossing to the next region comes in a later build. The run's saved here.

road.title: The Road
road.stay: Leave {name} to hold it. It pays in full while they do.
road.nobody: Leave nobody. It pays half, and holdings drift back.
road.carried: Funds, the command party and the box come with you. The base stays where it is.
road.heroAhead: The Hero's already on the next map.

regard: A front page: "Strangers Mend the Bridge." Somebody's cut it out and pinned it up.
A letter from a local: they say thank you, and spell your name wrong.
dread: A child's drawing on a wall: a coat in your colours, and teeth.
A front page: "Who Are They?" The photograph's of the back of somebody's head.
plain: Nothing much. A shop changed its sign.
The ferry's running late again. Nobody blames you. Yet.

road.letter: {name}, from {town}: "Quiet. The baker's mother's better. I said you'd asked."
letters: "Quiet. The baker's mother's better. I said you'd asked."
"Rain all week. Nobody's turned. I'm eating well."
"Somebody tried the back door. It was a cat. I'm telling you anyway."
"They've started saying good morning. I don't know what to do with that."
road.recall: {name}'s back from {town}. Nobody holds it now.
road.doubleBack: A letter from someone who still lives in {town}: "One of the kids who walks with the Hero came back through. {n} of yours turned."
road.doubleBackNone: A letter from someone who still lives in {town}: "One of the kids who walks with the Hero came back through. Nothing of yours turned. They looked."

drift.line: {where} in {town} drifted back to its owner. Nobody was there to hold it.

tally.said: Nobody said anything worth writing down.

waysForward.means: Wages unpaid. Loyalty falls for those paid least, first.
waysForward.way: Hold cheaper: let somebody go kindly, or take a holding that pays. One Last Job and the whip-round come with the economy.
waysForward.waits: One Last Job and the Whip-Round, slice 11

waysForward.way: The Boss can still take one holding a day in person. One applicant always comes the next morning: someone who's always wanted to.

waysForward.means: The Boss is a Grunt in their own team.
waysForward.way: The run goes on from the other side of the Roster.

waysForward.means: Rule by fear: Loyalty capped at 5 for the region.
waysForward.way: The cap lifts at the Crossing.
A safehouse becomes the base, at Small, with one room. Heat falls to 4.
The Town always has a room to let. At Dread 8 a local the team once helped offers their barn.
Healed at once. The job fails; the day goes on.

waysForward.means: A relic taken; a Key that turned out false.
waysForward.way: Every part has a second source in a later district, at a higher price.
Nothing needs doing. The Reckoning comes on its own day whatever the Hero's pace. A fast Hero arrives knowing less.
The Scheme ending's still open. So's the last room.

waysForward.means: The Hero's got the Badges and the team's got none.
waysForward.way: The base still stands. The Reckoning's still the Reckoning. A team that held nothing and built a kitchen has still built a kitchen.

waysForward.state: The Boss doesn't want to go on
waysForward.way: The Hand-Off's open from Region 2 with any Officer. Walking into the station's on the Board from Heat 6.

patrons.name: A former Executive
patrons.line: I gave eleven years to a man who never learned my name. You've asked it twice already. That's two more than him. Where d'you want the desk?
patrons.gives: Dispatch is one squad larger, all run.

person.name: Carrow
person.note: A Rocket clerk who kept the books and was never once in the room.

patrons.name: A disgraced Gym Leader
patrons.line: I lost it fairly. That's the worst part. I'd like it back the same way. I'm told you can arrange a challenge.
patrons.gives: Replace is open from the first District, with the Patron as the Officer. Outplay +10% while they're on the Roster.

person.name: Hartley Moss
person.note: Held a Kanto Gym nine years and lost it fairly.

patrons.limit: Their old Gym in Region 2 waits for the Crossing.

patrons.name: A struck-off Professor
patrons.line: They said the readings were impossible. They didn't say they were wrong. I need a room, a generator and four people who don't ask what it's for.

person.name: Prof. Aurelia Sedgwick-Otieno
person.note: Struck off for bad method. Not for that.

patrons.limit: Her free first room waits for the base (slice 10).

patrons.name: A Champion who quit
patrons.line: I held it six years. I walked out the day I worked out what it was for. I'm not here to help you. I'll tell you which Gym the child's heading for; that's all.
patrons.gives: The Hero's next Gym is always shown, and how many days until they reach it.
patrons.limit: Her one battle waits for a later slice. She doesn't go on jobs or draw a wage.

patrons.name: A Grunt who's seen three Bosses
patrons.line: First one shouted. Second one cried. Third one left in the night with the float. I'll tell you now what I want: a pension. In writing.
patrons.gives: Team Loyalty never drops below 2. He wants ₽200 a day as a pension.

patrons.name: Nobody
patrons.gives: +50% starting Funds. No teacher: four notes on the door in your own hand.

cuts: Whatever they came in, with an armband

cold.line: People have seen this before. Every local's first mood is one colder.

warm.cut: Whatever they came in, with an armband
warm.line: Grunts can't be told from townsfolk. Locals trust them a mood warmer.

look.eyebrow: The Patron raises an eyebrow: "whatever it takes" on a Clean hands team.
